selected_navigation.text: Elections  Thoughtful About Berwick’s Future? This Is Your Moment • Select Board Papers Available Feb. 26  Two seats on the Berwick Select Board will be on the ballot this year, and nomination papers become available beginning February 26. According to Town Manager Arthur Capello, anyone interested in running can pick up papers from the Town Clerk starting that day. Candidates must gather at least 25 and no more than 100 signatures from registered Berwick voters.

second_navigation.text: Elections  Berwick Election Results Are In After Record June Turnout  Berwick’s June election turned into a two-day count this week after more than 1,800 voters cast ballots in what town officials believe may be a record turnout for a June election in Berwick. The municipal results were signed by the Town Clerk on June 11, following a long Election Day marked by steady lines, hot weather, a nine-page ballot, and the use of an auxiliary ballot box to keep voters moving.
